title: Carina portrait faces: neutral, surprised, tired (his prompt, 3 seeds each)
question: Which of these are Carina's neutral, surprised and tired faces?

media.caption: Numbered, in order made. Row 1 neutral: 1-3 his prompt as is, 4-6 plus "neutral expression, closed mouth". Row 2 surprised 7-9 ("surprised, eyes wide open, small open mouth"). Row 3 tired 10-12 ("tired, half-lidded eyes, slight eye bags, slumped relaxed look"). Seeds 390617760, 390617761, 390617762 in each group. His approved render is at the end of row 2. PASS: 1, 4, 6, 7. DRIFT: the rest (seed ...761 turns her head the other way and hides the brow piercings; some others lose the brow piercings). All 12 shown, none picked.

options.label: 1. neutral-asis-1
options.note: Seed 390617760. His prompt and negative unchanged; none (his prompt as is). rdbtAnima, 896x1152, euler_ancestral normal, 30 steps, CFG 5. PASS: teal eyes, dark roots, ear ring, 2 brow piercings, his smile. imgqa: red rim 0.5%, ccip drift 0.001 (pass), framing warn: hair touches the top edge (his own render does too). Second image is the cut-out (isnet-anime + matte_refine, no other pixel changes).
